title: Comment claims extracted JS ends in '},' but the extraction region stops at the closing quote of the 'return scrub(p);' literal, so the comma strip is a no-op
detail: closeQuote is the first quote after the END anchor — the closing quote of the `<> "return scrub(p);"` literal — so a later `<> "},"` literal is never captured; js never ends in `,`, the `,$` strip is dead, and the comment misstates the extracted bytes.
recommended_fix: Either extend the region to include the closing `<> "},"` literal so the comment and strip are true, or drop the `,$` strip and correct the comment to `...return scrub(p);}` with no trailing comma.

title: New node:test regression suite ships with no runner wiring in this diff
location: scripts/js-tests/apply_event_scrub.test.js (new file; diff contains no harness change)
evidence:
diff --git a/scripts/js-tests/apply_event_scrub.test.js b/scripts/js-tests/apply_event_scrub.test.js
new file mode 100644
(only other files in the diff: server/src/application/form_view.gleam, server/test/application/form_view_test.gleam — no package.json, Makefile, or CI change)
detail: The diff adds a node:test file but no package.json script, Makefile target, or CI step to run it. If the repo's JS harness enumerates test files explicitly, this suite — including the negative control that claims to 'prove the suite bites' — never executes.
recommended_fix: Wire scripts/js-tests into the existing runner (e.g. `node --test` glob) or add an explicit invocation in the Makefile/CI so the regression suite runs in pr-checks.
